messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD-CHARGE-842: reserved-pool-eviction-rate-high for tenant=marigold-health (dedicated-pool id: dp-14) :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Incident created: PD-CHARGE-842. Urgency: high. Trigger: reserved_pool/eviction_rate > 20% for 1m.
olivia (oncall): Acked. I'm on it. Starting triage.
raj (infra): grabbing metrics — seeing eviction_rate spike + kernel reclaim events on dp-14 hosts. I/O stalls around 12:32 UTC.
incident-bot: Attachments: links to /dashboards/dp-14/evictions, /logs/hosts/dp-14.
sara (runtime): Noting elevated kv-cache misses and a surge in RT QPS from marigold-health routes. Could be a bad workload causing huge prefix churn.
olivia (oncall): Adding context: customer traffic ramped ~11:55 per logs. CS pinged earlier but no reported user outage yet. @marta fyi.
marta (cs): Confirmed — Marigold reported intermittent 503s earlier but thought it was transient. They're on standby.
raj (infra): Host list for dp-14: g4-3, g4-4, g4-5. g4-4 shows repeated `dkms` OOM kills and high disk latency. Attaching logs snippet:
```
Mar 03 12:31:58 g4-4 kernel: memory: page reclaim stall detected
Mar 03 12:32:01 g4-4 systemd: process qemu-kvm invoked oom-killer
```

kevin (eng-platform): If it's kernel reclaim, we should try reducing tenant IO footprint quickly — enable tenant QoS throttling and shift marigold-health to their burst queue limit. Command: `rctl set-tenant marigold-health --burst-limit=0.3`
olivia (oncall): Executing `rctl` now. Output: `OK: tenant updated`.
incident-bot: Noted config change.
raj (infra): I'm going to cordon g4-4 and drain to avoid noisy neighbor compounding. Starting drain now.
sara (runtime): To reduce KV cache churn, push a temporary routing policy to prefer model-quantized variant (mq-lite) for marigold-health until stable. That reduces memory pressure. Plan: update route -> `route update --tenant marigold-health --model mq-lite --timeout 1s`
olivia (oncall): Applying route change. `route update` returned 200.
olivia (oncall): Observing metrics after changes: eviction_rate dropping from 28% -> 9% over 2m, latency p95 improving from 1.6s -> 420ms. Still seeing some 503s but decreasing.
marta (cs): Looping in customer PM on support ticket. Notifying Marigold that we're mitigating and will follow up.
kevin (eng-platform): Will re-run placement to add one extra host to dp-14 (preemptively scale). K8s cluster has capacity in region, requesting autoscale +1.
oncall-rotation-bot: @olivia scheduled handoff in 20 minutes to @raj if issue persists.
olivia (oncall): PD note: created postmortem draft PD-CHARGE-842, marking as triage. Adding timeline to incident.
raj (infra): g4-4 drain done. Replaced with g4-6 (new host). New host warmed, KV cache miss rate steady.
sara (runtime): Recommend keeping mq-lite route for 30m, then can roll back if stable. Also suggest adding a regression alert on tenant-level prefix churn so we detect next time earlier.
marta (cs): Customer acknowledges and appreciates fast response. Asked for RCA once postmortem is ready.
olivia (oncall): Closing PD auto-escalation for now — monitoring. If eviction_rate creeps above 15% again, PD will re-page.
incident-bot: Alert status -> acknowledged, mitigated, monitoring.
olivia (oncall): Quick takeaway for postmortem bullets: noisy workload from marigold-health caused KV cache churn -> kernel reclaim + host IO stalls -> reserved-pool evictions + higher latency -> partial 503s. Mitigations: tenant QoS quota, route to mq-lite, drain noisy host and add replacement host. Owners: raj (infra) for host issues, sara (runtime) for routing/cache, marta (cs) for customer comms.
olivia (oncall): Handing off to @raj for long-running follow-ups and postmortem. I'm available if anything re-pages. :thumbsup:
